turns.prompt: In a binary min-heap stored in an array, where is the smallest element and where is the largest? What do inserting an item and removing the minimum cost, and why?
turns.answer: The smallest element is always at the root of the heap (index 0), while the largest element can only be found among the leaf nodes – roughly the second half of the array – because the heap only enforces a parent‑≤‑children order and is not fully sorted.
